### Why Did the Women in Exodus 38:8 Give Their Mirrors for the Brazen Altar?
Author: Barbara Latta
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/why-did-the-women-in-exodus-388-give-their-mirrors.html
Passage: Exodus 38:8
Points:
- The polished bronze mirrors carried out of Egypt were symbols of personal vanity and worldly culture.
- Donating these valuable mirrors for the tabernacle basin reflected a heart willing to prioritize God above self.
- The women stationed at the entrance modeled an enduring legacy of worship, praise, and humble ministry.
- Believers are challenged to release self-focus and pride so that Christ may increase in their lives of service.
